description: This file defines a factory pattern for creating different types of Playwright browser contexts, including shared, isolated, remote, CDP, and persistent contexts. It includes classes and functions for managing browser instances, context creation, and configuration handling within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: BaseContextFactory
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing common logic for creating and managing Playwright browser contexts, including browser instance handling and context cleanup.

classes.name: IsolatedContextFactory
classes.description: Creates isolated browser contexts with specific launch options, including trace collection and error handling.

classes.name: CdpContextFactory
classes.description: Creates browser contexts connected over Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP).

classes.name: RemoteContextFactory
classes.description: Creates browser contexts connected to remote Playwright endpoints.

classes.name: PersistentContextFactory
classes.description: Creates persistent browser contexts with user data directories, handling retries and cleanup.

classes.name: SharedContextFactory
classes.description: Singleton class managing shared browser contexts across multiple clients.

methods.name: contextFactory
methods.description: Factory function to select and instantiate the appropriate BrowserContextFactory based on configuration.

methods.name: identityBrowserContextFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory that returns a fixed, existing browser context.

methods.name: createHash
methods.description: Generates a short SHA-256 hash from input data.

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.description: Adds initialization scripts to a browser context.

methods.name: computeTracesDir
methods.description: Determines the directory for storing trace files based on configuration.

methods.name: browserContextOptionsFromConfig
methods.description: Builds browser context options from configuration, including video recording settings.
